content: Supabase custom profiles pattern: create a public.profiles table with id uuid references auth.users(id), plus a role column. Create a handle_new_user() function (SECURITY DEFINER, LANGUAGE plpgsql, owned by postgres) that inserts a row into profiles reading fields from NEW.raw_user_meta_data (e.g. role, full_name) passed at signup/invite time; attach it as an AFTER INSERT trigger on auth.users named on_auth_user_created. Role is written once at creation from metadata but read from profiles thereafter (metadata is just the transfer mechanism, not the source of truth).
